groups.label: Bold / Modern
groups.description: Confident geometric and grotesque sans faces with heavy weights; punchy hooks, stats and calls to action.

groups.label: Editorial Serif
groups.description: Magazine and book serifs for thoughtful long-form slides, quotes and storytelling.

groups.label: Playful
groups.description: Rounded, bouncy and friendly faces for casual, fun or kid-friendly content.

groups.label: Minimal
groups.description: Neutral, highly legible sans faces that stay out of the way; clean layouts and body copy.

groups.label: Tech
groups.description: Grotesks, monospace and sci-fi faces for developer, SaaS, data and futuristic content.

groups.label: Luxury
groups.description: High-contrast serifs and refined thin sans for fashion, beauty, real estate and premium brands.

groups.label: Handwritten
groups.description: Scripts and marker hands for personal notes, annotations and accents. Use sparingly, headings only.

groups.label: Display / Condensed
groups.description: Tall, narrow, all-caps-friendly faces that fit big words in tight space; headlines and numbers.
